# Migration run configuration. The agent reads this file. The agent does
# not hardcode anything from it. Survey 230926: generous budgets so the
# agent can work; the sweep driver overrides the model.

run:
  # Model that drives the agent (ollama model tag). Overridable with --model.
  model: qwen3.8:27b-mtp-q4_K_M
  # Turn budget for the agent tool loop. Generous: the survey wants the
  # agent to finish its plan, not to die on a ceiling. The driver logs the
  # turns each run actually used.
  max_turns: 120
  # Model context window.
  num_ctx: 16384
  # Max output tokens per model call (ollama num_predict). Large models
  # spend the first chunk on thinking blocks before the tool call.
  max_output_tokens: 8192
  # Whole-run retries when a model turn truncates or errors.
  max_retries: 2
  # Thinking mode on: the models reason before tool calls, and the
  # resilience hook retries a turn the provider cut short.
  think: true
  # Sampling temperature. Low value for deterministic tool use.
  temperature: 0.2

output:
  # Destination root for the transformed codebase and run logs. The sweep
  # driver rewrites this per run.
  dir: /home/ayin/projs/ARCMiS/experiments/230926/runs/chtrie/recode/qwen3.8_27b-mtp-q4_K_M/rep1/workspace

# Recode fix-round ceiling. The first execution round plus up to ten
# fix rounds: the agent decides when the code is done, the ceiling only
# guards a runaway loop.
recode:
  max_rounds: 11

# Ledger budget split: the manager and each fresh worker delegation carry
# separate turn budgets.
ledger:
  manager_turns: 60
  worker_turns: 120
  retries: 2

source:
  # Input codebase to transform. From the ReCodeAgent dataset (crust,
  # C to Rust pair).
  language: c
  root: assets/ReCodeAgent/data/tool_projects/crust/chtrie/c
  # Target language and toolchain for the output codebase and the test run.
  target:
    language: rust
    # Cargo test invocation for the translated tests. The runner and
    # profile come from the toolchain.
    test_co...
